diagnostics.message: `aws_cloudfront_distribution.default` sets `depends_on = [aws_s3_bucket.origin]`, but the dependency is already established implicitly: the primary `origin { domain_name = local.bucket_domain_name }` resolves (in the default `origin_bucket == null` case) through `local.origin_bucket` to `aws_s3_bucket.origin[0].bucket_regional_domain_name`/`.website_endpoint`, so Terraform already orders the bucket before the distribution (and after it on destroy). The explicit `depends_on` is redundant. (When an existing bucket is supplied the managed bucket has count 0, so the `depends_on` is a no-op anyway.)
